IMPORTANT: this is dremling's actual art file despite the confusingly-named-the-other-way filenames in this family (drem's own file is npc/horror_corrupted_dremling.png -- names are swapped between the two identities; verified against source). Large hulking black-skinned humanoid, spiky scabrous ridges, featureless hollow eye sockets, waraxe.

prompt_fields.subject: A hulking, broad-shouldered black-skinned humanoid warrior covered in jagged spiky scabrous ridges along its back, shoulders and forearms. Its face is entirely featureless -- no eyes, nose or mouth, just smooth obsidian-black skin with hollow dark eye sockets where a face would be. It grips a battered stone waraxe low and ready.
prompt_fields.contrast: First non-unique horror/corrupted identity in the catalog (existing horror-corrupted entries are all unique bosses: Horned Horror is a horned minotaur-like figure, The Mouth is a low wide red toothed mass, The Abomination is a tall pale two-headed spire). Dremling must read as a fourth, clearly different silhouette from all three: an upright hulking humanoid with a jagged spiky ridge crown along the shoulders/back and a completely blank, hollow-socketed face -- no horns, no visible mouth, no pale colouring. Silhouette (hulking humanoid + spiky ridge crest) and value (deep matte obsidian-black body against the neutral disc, not the pale/red tones of its shipped horror-corrupted siblings) are the anchors.
prompt_fields.composition: One compact complete creature on a single circular tabletop disc, steep overhead three-quarter camera; visible clear neutral base ring on every side. Keep all anatomy and equipment well inside the inner four-fifths of disc radius. Base brightness must visually match reference neutral disc, with no illumination spill or ground effects. Base-plate discipline, calibrated from monster-batch-d/monster-batch-e on this same style reference: an initial 8-unit-darker disc instruction overshot to base_drift -9 to -15 on several fresh generations, while a follow-up 4-unit-darker instruction landed cleanly inside the +-8 tolerance on a controlled retest (-5.11). Render the neutral disc -- including the whole outer-sixth ring band -- only about 4 RGB luminance units darker than the style reference's disc appears at first read: a small, conservative undershoot, not a full shade darker. Do not darken the creature itself to compensate -- only the disc plate takes this small intentional downward bias. Add no warm cast, glow, bounce-light, gradient or vignette to the disc anywhere, including directly under or behind dark-bodied creatures.
prompt_fields.palette: Deep matte obsidian-black skin with a faint cool blue-grey sheen on the spiky ridges so the silhouette edge stays legible against the disc, small dull grey stone waraxe head, no bright accents anywhere on the body (the blank hollow eye sockets are darker-than-skin voids, not a glowing highlight); dry neutral charcoal disc with restrained copper-grey bevel, kept a visibly lighter value than the creature's skin so the two never merge.
